title: Menger Springs Commercial Development Sites

rows.label: Location
rows.text: The property is comprised of 6 lots in Menger Springs that sit just south and adjacent to the Methodist Healthcare facility in Boerne. It is just south of the IH 10 at Highway 46 interchange.

rows.label: Utilities
rows.note: Prospective buyers should retain an independent engineer to verify the location, accessibility and available capacity of all utilities.

rows.label: Zoning
rows.text: C-1, Commercial, City of Boerne, Texas
rows.note: Prospective buyers should verify the zoning and permitted uses for this property with the appropriate governing authority.

rows.label: Traffic
rows.text: 2024 Texas Department of Transportation maps indicate 57,215 vehicles per day on IH 10 just east of the property.

rows.label: Demographics
rows.note: Source: U.S. Bureau of the Census, 2020 Census of Population and Housing. ESRI forecasts for 2025 and 2030.

rows.label: Flood Plain
rows.text: The Federal Emergency Management Agency maps appear to indicate that there isn’t any floodplain on this property.

rows.label: Topography
rows.text: The property generally slopes and drains from west to east/north.

rows.label: Deed Restrictions
rows.text: Restrictions and covenants are in place to promote the overall quality of development in Menger Springs. Contact Broker.

rows.label: Area Development
rows.text: The Menger Springs subdivision, Methodist medical office building and ambulatory surgery center and Morningside Ministries senior care are adjacent to the properties. Significant commercial development including H.E.B. and Home Depot are just north of the properties at the IH 10 and Highway 46 interchange.

rows.label: Potential Use
rows.text: Office, healthcare, and other commercial uses

comments: Exceptional growth within the Boerne metro area is driving the need for retail, office and other commercial uses, as well as healthcare services.
The property is located along Menger Springs Road, adjacent to Methodist Healthcare with great access to IH 10.

qa_notes: LOT COUNT CONTRADICTION: Location says 'comprised of 6 lots', but Exhibit A (p7) shows seven lots (Lots 1-7: 3.57 + 1.12 + 1.45 + 1.57 + 1.51 + 1.65 + 0.84 = 11.71 AC) plus a 1.65 AC street, which together total the 13.36 acres. The $2,618,827.20 price (= 13.36 ac x 43,560 x $4.50) therefore includes the 1.65 ac street area. Broker should confirm lot count and priced acreage.
ZONING CONTRADICTION: spec says 'C-1, Commercial, City of Boerne, Texas'; every lot on Exhibit A is marked 'B-1'. Prismic zoning 'C-1, City of Boerne' matches the spec wording (minus 'Commercial').

TRAFFIC DATA AGE: spec cites 2024 TxDOT 57,215 vpd on IH 10, while the included Esri Traffic Count Map (p9) is dated February 10, 2017 (©2016 Kalibrate) and uses 1/3/5-mile rings vs the 3/5/7-mile demographics. The p9 page is stale relative to the rest of the package.

TITLE: cover headline is one line 'MENGER SPRINGS COMMERCIAL DEVELOPMENT SITES' with 'BOERNE, TEXAS' below; there is no separate tagline, so eyebrow is blank and the full line is the title. If the template needs an eyebrow, the natural split is eyebrow 'Commercial Development Sites' / title 'Menger Springs'. Prismic title is 'Menger Springs Road' and the demographic page says 'MENGER SPRINGS ROAD – BOERNE, TX'.
PRICE: $2,618,827.20 or $4.50 per SF; Prismic total_price '$2,618,827' (rounded) and '$4.50 / SF' (match).
SIZE: spec '13.36 +/- Acres'; Prismic 13.36 acres (match). Cover has no acreage line, so size_headline is blank.
TRANSACTION: the PDF never says 'For Sale'/'For Lease'; set to 'For Sale' from the Investment price. Prismic transaction_type is null.
